proposals.title: Shareholder Proxy Access Amendments
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend the proxy access bylaw so shareholder nominees may number 20% of directors or 2, whichever is greater.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 4.

proposals.title: True Diversity Board Policy
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy disclosing board nominee minimum qualifications and each nominee's skills, ideological perspectives, and experience in a chart or matrix.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 5.
